olivia (Support): Heads-up — auditor Riley asked for a SOC2 evidence bundle tied to the outage on 2025-11-05. They want KMS/HSM key rotation history, API auth failures around 03:12 UTC, and proof of log retention chain. forwarding their questions below.

auditor_riley (Auditor): Thanks. Please provide: 1) KMS key versioning + rotation timestamps for keys used by inference-control (key-id: redwood-infer-01). 2) HSM access audit (if applicable) for 2025-11-05 02:50–03:30 UTC. 3) API auth failure rate + sample request IDs for the 03:12 spike. 4) Signed manifest showing when logs were exported and retained. Need sample logs and repro steps to verify.

maria (Security): Copy. We can provide key rotation metadata (CMK ARN + rotation events) and a signed manifest from our key management logs. Sam — can you pull HSM admin access events for that window? Also need to know if any rotation coincided with the incident.

sam (SRE): On it. Quick note: our HSM runs on-provider HSM service; admin events show a single operator login at 01:58 UTC, no admin ops after that. I'm starting an export: `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=cloudhsm AND timestamp>=\"2025-11-05T02:50:00Z\" AND timestamp<=\"2025-11-05T03:30:00Z\"\" --format=json > /tmp/hsm-20251105.json` Will upload partial bundle to the secure share and paste link when ready.

deepak (Engineering): I dug into the API error spike. Root cause looks like a transient auth token validation latency against the KMS signing service. We have a repro with a small script that simulates 250 concurrent token verifications; latency tail climbs when KV cache misses. Repro snippet:```bash
export TARGET=https://api.redwood-infer.internal/auth/verify
for i in {1..250}; do curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN\" $TARGET & done; wait
```
Sample failing request IDs: r-20251105-03-12-1121, r-20251105-03-12-1134, r-20251105-03-12-1167. I captured server-side traces and attached truncated logs to the bundle.

auditor_riley (Auditor): Need the signed manifest to prove the logs weren't tampered with after export. Hashes (sha256) + timestamp + who exported. Also want to confirm log retention policy (company-wide vs. key-specific).

maria (Security): Policy: access and auth logs retention = 2 years by default; keystore rotation metadata retained for 7 years per internal control C-34. We'll include the policy excerpt. For manifests: evidence-bot can produce signed export manifests with the system signature (HSM-signed thumbprint). evidence-bot: can you generate manifest for the export containing logs: `/exports/2025/11/05/hsm-auth-03-12.json`, `/exports/2025/11/05/api-traces-03-12.json`?

_evidence-bot_: Manifest generated for requested files. Signed manifest SHA256: `a3b9f8e2d4b6c22f8e5f6d9c7b4a1e2f3d4c5b6a7e8f9d0c1b2a3d4e5f6a7b8`. Exported by svc-evidence@redwood-infer on 2025-11-05T04:22:10Z. Link: https://r-infer-secure.s3.redwood-infer/exports/2025/11/05/manifest-20251105.json (access: auditor_riley@auditor-company.com)

auditor_riley (Auditor): Good — I can access the manifest link. Please also provide an MD5/sha256 for the raw log objects and the kms key version IDs with timestamps (ideally `keyVersionId` + `rotationTimestamp`).

maria (Security): Attached in the bundle: `kms-rotation.csv` (columns: keyId,keyVersionId,rotationTimestamp,rotatedBy), `log-hashes.csv` (objectPath,sha256,md5,exportedAt). Sam confirmed HSM admin logs show no suspicious admin operations in the window.

sam (SRE): Uploads complete. Partial sample note: we redacted customer PII from the sampled requests per compliance. Object links (auditor access granted): `s3://r-infer-secure/exports/2025/11/05/hsm-auth-03-12.json` and `s3://r-infer-secure/exports/2025/11/05/api-traces-03-12.json`.

auditor_riley (Auditor): Thanks. One last ask — can you include the runbook steps used during the incident, and a short timeline of actions (who did what and when)? We need that for our control evidence.

olivia (Support): I'll pull the incident timeline from PagerDuty + Incident doc and add the communications log. Quick Q for Deepak: does your repro require internal feature flags enabled? We need to ensure auditor can reproduce without internal-only flags.

deepak (Engineering): No internal flags. The repro uses standard token verification endpoint and a test token we can generate for auditor. I'll add a small README with steps and expected outputs (including how to identify the failure by `request id`).

maria (Security): Plan: compile the evidence bundle (manifests, hashes, kms rotations, hsm admin export, api traces, incident timeline, runbook) and upload to secure share by EOD PST. Riley — can you confirm if you need the raw traces unredacted for full verification (we'll arrange a controlled review if necessary)?

auditor_riley (Auditor): We'll first review redacted traces. If we need full traces, we'll request a controlled on-site or a secure-access session. This should be sufficient to start. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

olivia (Support): Thanks team — assigning follow-ups: @maria prepare policy excerpt + kms csv, @sam verify HSM export hashes, @deepak add README + repro token, @evidence-bot finalize manifest with signed timestamp. I'll update the auditor thread when bundle is uploaded. :thumbsup:
